title: Creamy Glassy Pasta Delight
description: A rich and indulgent pasta dish featuring a glassy sauce. Perfect for a cozy evening in.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a medium saucepan, combine the jelly and glassy. Heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pot. Add the jelly-glassy sauce and toss to combine.
